outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic of breast anatomy plus a classification table of breast cancer subtypes; it is not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B is a schematic diagram illustrating circadian phenotypes and their relationship to drug sensitivity/tumor growth; no data plot is shown.
Panel C is a schematic depicting the luciferase recording method, not a data plot.

Panel D shows idealized line traces of circadian signals (illustrating stationary/non-stationary analysis) plus a schematic workflow; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel E is a correlation heatmap of circadian parameters; heatmaps are exempt since individual points are not meaningful in this context.
Panel F contains an illustrative line plot of cell number vs. days for representative models, not a bar chart of averages requiring individual points.
Panel G shows illustrative dose-response line curves, which are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel H shows gene expression and mutation heatmaps; heatmaps are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel I shows PCA and 3D scatter plots of clusters/phenotypes; scatter plots inherently display individual data points, so no additional overlay is needed.
